items.exampleEn: The temple walls are covered with mythological scenes.
items.exampleZh: 寺廟的牆上畫滿了神話場景。

items.exampleEn: Aesthetically, the old train station is the city's finest building.
items.exampleZh: 從美感來看，那座老火車站是全市最出色的建築。

items.exampleEn: The earth's magnetism helps some birds find their way.
items.exampleZh: 地球的磁性幫助一些鳥類找到方向。

items.exampleEn: The back cover has a short synopsis of the novel.
items.exampleZh: 封底有這本小說的簡短大綱。

items.exampleEn: Demography helps cities plan schools and hospitals.
items.exampleZh: 人口統計學能幫助城市規劃學校和醫院。

items.exampleEn: His second album is stylistically closer to jazz.
items.exampleZh: 他的第二張專輯在風格上更接近爵士樂。

items.exampleEn: Our customers are demographically very similar to those of our rivals.
items.exampleZh: 就人口特徵來說，我們的顧客和競爭對手的顧客非常相似。

items.exampleEn: The area is geologically active, with frequent small earthquakes.
items.exampleZh: 這個地區在地質上很活躍，經常發生小地震。

items.sentenceEn: Please read the synopsis before you watch the play.
items.sentenceZh: 看戲之前，請先讀一下劇情大綱。

items.audioEn: Geologically, this island is very young; it formed only about a million years ago.
items.audioZh: 就地質而言，這座島非常年輕，大約一百萬年前才形成。
items.questionZh: 關於這座島，說話者說了什麼？
options: It is young in geological terms.

items.sentenceEn: The singer's personal magnetism attracted huge crowds.
items.sentenceZh: 那位歌手的個人魅力吸引了大批人潮。

items.sentenceEn: Stylistically, the two paintings are very different.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩幅畫在風格上非常不同。

items.stemEn: The new park is ____ pleasing, with flowers and curved paths.
items.stemZh: 新公園有花和彎曲的小徑，賞心悅目。

items.stemEn: The city is ____ older than most, with many residents over sixty-five.
items.stemZh: 這座城市的人口結構比多數城市老，很多居民超過六十五歲。

items.passageEn: The city museum's new exhibition explores mythological creatures from around the world, from giant birds to sea spirits. Each room begins with a short synopsis of the stories behind the objects. Stylistically, the works range from simple wooden figures to bright modern paintings, and some pieces evoke strong feelings of wonder. The organizers say the exhibition is aesthetically pleasing but also educational. One room shows how ancient sailors may have explained magnetism through myths. Surprisingly, the visitors are not only children; a study of the demography of the museum's visitors shows that most are adults between thirty and fifty.
items.passageZh: 市立博物館的新展覽探索世界各地的神話生物，從巨鳥到海中精靈都有。每個展間一開始都有一段簡短的摘要，介紹展品背後的故事。在風格上，作品從簡單的木頭人像到色彩鮮豔的現代畫都有，有些作品還會喚起強烈的驚奇感。主辦單位說，這個展覽賞心悅目，也具有教育意義。其中一個展間展示古代水手可能如何用神話來解釋磁力。令人意外的是，參觀者不只有小孩；一項針對博物館觀眾人口結構的研究顯示，大多數是三十到五十歲的成人。

questions.questionZh: 每個展間一開始有什麼？
options: 一段介紹故事背景的簡短摘要

questions.questionZh: 研究顯示大多數參觀者是什麼人？
options: 從國外來的觀光客團體
學校安排來參觀的小學生
研究神話的大學教授們

items.promptZh: 這兩個地區在地質上很相似。
referenceEn: These two areas are geologically similar.
Geologically, the two regions are very much alike.
rubricZh: geologically 表示「在地質上」，位置有彈性（例如 geologically similar、Geologically, … 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 mythological 造一個句子，說說你知道或喜歡的某個神話人物或生物。
referenceEn: My favorite mythological creature is a horse with wings.
I enjoy reading about mythological heroes from Greece.
rubricZh: mythological 是形容詞，表示「神話的」（例如 a mythological creature、mythological stories 等）
句子要說到你自己的喜好或認識

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：a study of the museum's demography 不自然：博物館本身沒有 demography，應為 a study of the museum's visitors／of visitor demographics
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "a study of the demography of the museum's visitors"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：temperamentally、demographically、geologically 與 u08-l03 q13 重複同組干擾項
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 改為 magnetically、ethically、geologically，與 u08-l03 不同組；不用 stylistically、acoustically（acoustically pleasing 是真實搭配）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：uncharacteristic、characterization 在 u07–u10 多課反覆當干擾項，且 characterization 為名詞、一眼可排除
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: uncharacteristic、characterization 換成 remotely（副詞，放得進空格但語意不通）與本課 synopsis，保留 enthusiastically

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（干擾項只用已教過的字）：magnetically 為 u08-l05 才教
執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
